title: Transition Floor Balance 3v0
description: Three players push the ball up the floor together, practising the lane assignments and spacing that keep a fast break organised.

content.objective: Keep the floor balanced in three lanes while pushing the ball up the court quickly.
content.setup: Three players start near half court, one with the ball in the middle lane.
instructions: The middle player pushes the ball while the outside two sprint wide lanes.
The wide players stay behind the ball slightly until a passing angle opens.
The ball handler reads the defense (or imagines it) and decides to pass or finish.
Reset at the far baseline and run it back the other way.
coachingPoints: Keep the three lanes spread — a bunched break is easy to defend.
Sprint with purpose, not just running fast in a random direction.
The ball handler should attack downhill, not drift sideways.
commonMistakes: Wide players drifting into the same lane as the ball handler.
Ball handler slowing down to wait for support instead of pushing the pace.
Crowding a teammate's space instead of keeping good spacing.
content.safety: Make sure the full length of the court is clear before sprinting at speed.
